_note: Config for emit_summit_matrix.py - the SUMMIT side of estMatrix for SPOT (the model's own estimates per snapshot, EUR millions). The consensus side is map_spot.json. Written Oct 20 2026 (DAA / Claude).
_derived_note: The model has no consolidated gross-profit row (only the two segment rows), so the dataset's `gp` is Premium + Ad-Supported gross profit, the same sum the results-data header already names.
_decimals_note: Millions at 1 decimal, like the hand-authored summit arrays.
_vintages_note: The four model snapshots in the MCP (2025-12-18 -> 2026-08-05). lastActual = the last period REPORTED when that file was saved (docs/profiles/SPOT.md, valuation-history table: 2025-12-18 and 2026-02-09 both stand after 3Q25; 2026-04-28 after 1Q26; 2026-08-05 after 2Q26). 2026-02-09 is the day before the 4Q25 print (Feb 10).
_views_note: MAU / subscribers / ad-supported MAU exist only in the 2025-12-18 snapshot (zero in the later three) and, there, only 4Q25 is a real estimate: 2026Q1 onward repeats a flat 737.6 / 295.1 / 442.6 placeholder. The post-filter in the pipeline script keeps only 4Q25 / FY2025 for those three.
_horizon_note: 2025-12-18: the model was mid-rebuild, every quarter after 4Q25 repeats the 1Q26 row (1Q27 = 1Q26, 2Q27 = 2Q26) and does not tie to its own annual, so only the next print (4Q25) is kept.
_repeat_note: Premium revenue / gross profit are held flat at the last real quarter in 2026-02-09 and 2026-04-28 (4Q26 = 1Q27 = 2Q27); the held-flat cells are placeholders, not estimates.
_axis_note: Same period axis as the Bloomberg matrix in js/results-data/spot.js.
